This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

```bash
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. - `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). - `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context

- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

149	### 4.2 greedy 行批式 indexed argmax
150	
151	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
152	
153	第一路处理「确定性行」：不管贪心是显式的（`temperature=0`）还是语义等价的（`top_p <= 1/selection_width` 核坍缩），这些行的正确答案都只有一个——分布的最大值下标。把它们**全部合并成一次批式 indexed argmax**：
154	
155	- **indexed** 的含义：argmax 核不扫整张 arena 的所有行，而是按一张行号表只取贪心行。行号表是紧凑的（长度 = 贪心行数），所以一次调用无论批内 1 行还是 64 行贪心，都只有一次 H2D、一次核发射、一次 D2H。
156	- **确定性**：argmax 核对 bf16 并列最大值按**最低下标**破并列。这与拒绝采样器「并列时靠种子随机挑一个」形成对照——正是 u2-l1 讲过的必须改道 argmax 的理由。
157	- **为什么不省掉 D2H**：调用方（引擎）需要把 token id 发回请求方，主机必须拿到这个 `u32`。所以这一路注定有一次设备→主机回读，也注定要等它（否则 `tokens` 里是垃圾）。回读的内存与同步纪律（pinned 页、`stream_spin_wait`）在 u4-l2 有专题，本讲只需要知道「等的是这次拷贝自己的事件」。
158	
159	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
160	
161	```text
162	greedy = [i32; 满足 is_argmax 的行号，升序]          # 主机侧紧凑列表
163	若 greedy 非空：
164	    memcpy_htod(greedy → scratch.row_indices)         # ① H2D：上传行号表
165	    argmax_batch_bf16_split_indexed_into(             # ② 核：按行号表做两阶段 argmax
166	        logits, row_indices, greedy.len(),
167	        partial_values, partial_indices,              #    split 归约的中间产物
168	        top1_values,                                  #    每 argmax 行的 top-1 logit（本函数不读）
169	        argmax_out)                                   #    每 argmax 行一个 token id
170	    memcpy_dtoh(argmax_out → scratch.argmax_host)     # ③ D2H：pinned 落地
171	    stream_spin_wait(ctx)                             # ④ 只等这次拷贝的事件
172	    for (k, row) in greedy:                           # ⑤ 按行号散写
173	        tokens[row] = argmax_host[k] as u32
174	```
175	
176	「两阶段 split argmax」是宽词表（15 万列）下的经典手法：先把每行切成 4096 宽的条带各算局部最大（partials 缓冲，长度公式见 u2-l2），再归约出全局 argmax。本讲把它当黑盒，只关心它的输入输出约定。

246	### 4.3 非 greedy 行：批式 FlashInfer 采样与 seeded 单行
247	
248	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
249	
250	第二、三路处理真正需要「抽签」的行，按**有没有请求级种子**再切一刀：
251	
252	- **无种子行（第二路）**：合并成一次 `gpu_sample_batch_into` 批式调用，共用引擎本步的种子。行与行的随机流靠 philox **子序列**去相关——批内第 `i` 行用的是这个种子下的第 `i` 条子序列。这是服务常态：绝大多数请求不带种子，追求的是批式吞吐。
253	- **带种子行（第三路）**：逐行构造**单元素**批，以 `mix_seed(request_seed, steps[i])` 为种子单独调用。原因在函数文档里写得很清楚：FlashInfer 的核把**批内位置**折进 philox 子序列——同一行在批首、批尾会拿到不同的随机流。要让「token 是 (seed, step, 分布) 的纯函数」这个可重放契约成立（与批组合、邻居、引擎种子都无关），唯一办法是让批内位置恒为 0，即单行调用（`blockIdx` 恒 0，[src/lib.rs:L293-L295](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L293-L295) 的注释）。
254	- **min_p 的自动分区**：`BatchSamplingRow` 携带 `min_p` 字段，但调用方**不需要**按 min_p 预先分组——`gpu_sample_batch_into` 内部会把 `min_p > 0` 的行切出来单独跑一遍。为什么在底层做而不在上层做？底层文档给了两个理由：min_p 核的 u 缩放（\( u \cdot q \)）与幸存者谓词和融合快路径不同，min_p=0 的行若搭错车会抽出不同的 token；在底层统一分区，能把「min_p=0 的行永远走原始快路径」变成对所有调用方都成立的承诺（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L87-L93](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L87-L93)）。
255	
256	`BatchSamplingRow` 的契约值得读一遍：贪心行（`temperature <= 0` 或 `top_k == 1`）明确**不属于**这个类型的目标用户，`top_k <= 0` 表示禁用，`min_p = 0.0` 表示禁用：[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L14-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L14-L29)。`select_batch` 的 argmax 过滤恰好保证了送进来的行都满足这份契约。

393	### 4.4 结果按行号归位：三路合流与基准语义
394	
395	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
396	
397	三路各自产生「自己集合内有序」的结果：argmax 输出按 `greedy` 行号表排序、批式采样输出按 `sampling_rows` 顺序、seeded 每次只有一个元素。而函数的返回契约是**按原始行序的 `Vec<u32>`**（文档 L162-L169：`params[i]` 治理第 `i` 行，返回第 `i` 个 token）。归位（scatter）就是把三种局部顺序映射回全局行号。
398	
399	归位的正确性依赖一个**划分不变量**：三个集合由两个谓词层层切开——
400	
401	\[ \underbrace{\{i : \text{is\_argmax}(p_i)\}}_{\text{第一路}} \;\Big|\; \underbrace{\{i : \neg\text{is\_argmax}(p_i) \wedge \text{seed}_i = \bot\}}_{\text{第二路}} \;\Big|\; \underbrace{\{i : \neg\text{is\_argmax}(p_i) \wedge \text{seed}_i = \top\}}_{\text{第三路}} \]
402	
403	三者两两不相交、并集为全集，所以 `tokens` 的每个下标**恰好被写一次**，初始化的 `0u32` 只是占位，永远不会残留到返回值里。
404	
405	基准的语义也挂在这套分发上。`benches/select_batch.rs` 固定 Qwen 词表 151 936，扫 batch ∈ {1, 8, 32, 64}，每档跑三种参数混合（[benches/select_batch.rs:L38-L74](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/benches/select_batch.rs#L38-L74)）：

407	| 档 | 参数 | 全部行落入 | 度量的是什么 |
408	|----|------|-----------|--------------|
409	| greedy | `p(0.0, -1, 1.0)` | 第一路 | 批式 indexed argmax 的成本下限（H2D + 核 + pinned D2H + 自旋） |
410	| sampling | `p(1.0, 50, 0.9)` | 第二路 | FlashInfer 批式采样通道的全额成本（gather + softmax + 采样 + 同步） |
411	| mixed | 偶数行贪心、奇数行采样 | 第一路 + 第二路 | 常见服务形态：一次调用顺序跑完两条路径 |

520	       //     改 steps[2] 或 seed 则变化；
521	       //  3) 行 4 的 token 与「只提交行 4」的单独调用一致
522	       //     （plain 趟内位置恒为 0）。

525	
526	4. **预期结果**：纸面部分应当完全确定；GPU 部分若本机无 GPU，先写出完整测试与预期断言并标注**待本地验证**，有 GPU 时用 `cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sample --test select_batch five_row -- --nocapture` 跑通。
527	5. **反思题**：行 2 的 token 为什么与引擎种子（第 5 个参数）无关，而行 4 的 token 与它强相关？

529	## 6. 本讲小结
530	
531	- `select_batch` 是唯一入口、没有逐行逃生舱：它把 `params` 按「`effectively_greedy` × 有无种子」切成三个互不相交的集合，顺序走三段路径，结果按原始行号合成一个 `Vec<u32>`。
532	- 顶部四个 `ensure!` 分别守护步数对齐、scratch 容量、arena 行数、vocab 宽度；超容量宁可报错也不扩容，因为解码缓冲的指针稳定性（CUDA 图）高于便利性。
533	- 贪心行合批走 indexed argmax：紧凑行号表 H2D → 一次核发射 → pinned D2H → 自旋只等该拷贝的事件（传递覆盖同流上更早的 argmax 核）→ 按行号散写。

# select_batch 三路分发：argmax、批式采样与 seeded 单行

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 沿着 `src/lib.rs` 里的 `select_batch` 主体，从上到下走通一次完整的批式选 token 调用：参数如何被切成三个集合、每个集合走哪条 GPU 路径、结果如何按行号归位。
2. 逐条说出函数顶部四个 `ensure!` 校验各自守护的不变量（步数对齐、scratch 容量、arena 行数、vocab 宽度），以及为什么违反它们必须报错而不是「将就着跑」。
3. 画出 greedy 行的完整数据流：主机行号表 H2D 上传 → 批式 indexed argmax → pinned 缓冲 D2H 回读 → 自旋等待 → 按行号散写回 `tokens`。
4. 解释无种子采样行为什么能合并成一次 FlashInfer 批式调用、`min_p` 行为什么在底层 `gpu_sample_batch_into` 内部被自动分区、带种子的行为什么必须逐行单调用。
5. 读懂 `benches/select_batch.rs` 里 greedy / sampling / mixed 三档基准各自度量的成本含义：greedy 是批式 argmax 的成本下限，mixed 是常见服务形态。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲建立在前两讲（u2-l1、u2-l2）的概念之上，开始前请确认你能回答这些问题：

- **logits arena 是什么**：一个 `HiddenStates` 设备缓冲，`seq_len` 是行数、`hidden_dim` 是每行宽度（= 词表宽度，可能被模型垫宽到 GEMM tile 倍数），数据是按行摊平的 bf16。解码步结束时，第 `i` 行是第 `i` 个请求「下一个 token 在整个词表上的偏好分布」（未归一化的 logit）。
- **`SamplingParams` 的字段**：`temperature` / `top_k` / `top_p` / `min_p` / `seed`（[pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs:L1-L16](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs#L1-L16)）。默认参数（temperature=0.0）就是贪心。
- **`is_greedy` 与 `effectively_greedy` 两级判定**（u2-l1）：前者只认显式贪心（`temperature < 1e-5 || top_k == 1`），后者追加「核坍缩」判据——softmax 最大概率恒满足 \( p_{\max} \ge 1/V \)，所以 `top_p <= 1/V` 时核里只剩 argmax 一个 token，这类行必须走确定性的 argmax 路径。
- **`SampleScratch` 的缓冲布局**（u2-l2）：贪心链与非贪心链住在互不相交的设备缓冲里，构造时按 `max_rows × vocab` 一次分配、长期持有，解码路径因 CUDA 图烘焙地址而要求指针稳定，**每步只写不重新分配**。
- **philox 与种子纪律**（本讲只要求直觉，细节在 u2-l4）：FlashInfer 采样核用 philox 计数器 RNG；一次批式调用共用一个种子，行与行靠 philox 子序列去相关；引擎种子每个解码步推进一次。

一个简单的术语表：

| 术语 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| 行（row） | arena 里的一行 logits，对应一个并发请求在本步的候选分布 |
| 贪心行 | `effectively_greedy` 为真的行，走批式 indexed argmax |
| 采样行 | 其余行，走 FlashInfer 温度/top-k/top-p 通道 |
| seeded 行 | `params[i].seed == Some(_)` 的采样行，逐行单调用以保证可重放 |
| H2D / D2H | 主机到设备 / 设备到主机的拷贝 |
| pinned 缓冲 | 固定页主机内存，D2H 拷贝可以保持异步（#704 教训，u4-l2 详述） |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

先给一张总览图。`select_batch` 把 `params` 切成三个**互不相交**的集合，按固定顺序依次处理，最后合成一个与输入行对齐的 `Vec<u32>`：

```text
params[0..n]（每行一份采样参数）
        │
        ├─ 集合 ①：effectively_greedy(p, selection_width) == true
        │      → 收集行号 [i32]，一次批式 indexed argmax
        │        （H2D 行号表 → argmax 核 → pinned D2H → 自旋等待）
        │
        ├─ 集合 ②：!effectively_greedy(p) 且 p.seed == None
        │      → 组装 Vec<BatchSamplingRow>，一次 gpu_sample_batch_into
        │        （min_p 行在底层再被自动分区出自己的 pass）
        │
        └─ 集合 ③：!effectively_greedy(p) 且 p.seed == Some(s)
               → 逐行构造单元素 [BatchSamplingRow]，
                 以 mix_seed(s, steps[i]) 为种子单调用

三路结果全部按「原始行号 i」写回 tokens[i] → Ok(tokens)
```

模块文档把这条设计线说得很直白：这个函数是「把一个 logits 竞技场变成每行一个 token id」的唯一入口，**没有逐行逃生舱**——调用方没法退化回 `for i { sample(i) }`（[src/lib.rs:L4-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L4-L11)）。三路分发正是这个承诺的实现方式：能批的尽量批，只有「可重放语义」强迫单行的 seeded 行例外。

### 4.1 前置校验与容量不变量

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`select_batch` 是解码热路径上的公共入口，五个模型 crate 都在用（例如 [pegainfer-gemma4/src/engine.rs:L984](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-gemma4/src/engine.rs#L984)、[pegainfer-qwen35/src/tp_executor.rs:L1570](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/tp_executor.rs#L1570)）。入口处的校验不是为了「礼貌」，而是在守护三条已经 baking 进缓冲布局的不变量：

1. **形状不变量**：scratch 的所有设备缓冲在构造时按 `max_rows × vocab` 定型（u2-l2）。batch 超容量或词表宽度不符，意味着后续每个核的形状检查都会失败——但与其让深处某个 FFI 调用报一个不知所云的错，不如在门口用带数字的错误信息拒绝。
2. **不重新分配纪律**：解码路径的指针稳定性（CUDA 图捕获）要求「每步只写不分配」。所以超容量时**绝不**临时扩缓冲，直接报错——调度器应该按 scratch 容量限制批大小，而不是让采样层悄悄扩容。
3. **参数对齐**：`steps` 与 `params` 是两条平行数组，长度不一致说明调用方组装批时出了 bug，这一步必须在任何 GPU 工作之前发现。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

函数主体最前面的执行顺序：

```text
n = params.len()
若 n == 0 → 直接返回空 Vec（空批短路，不碰 GPU）
ensure!(steps.len() == n)        # 平行数组对齐
ensure!(n <= scratch.max_rows)   # 容量
ensure!(logits.seq_len >= n)     # arena 行数够用
vocab = logits.hidden_dim
ensure!(vocab == scratch.vocab)  # 词表宽度一致
```

注意最后一个校验的两侧：**形状校验用 `scratch.vocab`（arena 物理宽度），而稍后的路由判定用 `scratch.selection_width`（可发射宽度）**——这正是 u2-l2 讲过的「vocab 管形状、selection_width 管路由」分工在源码里的落点。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

空批短路——零行请求不产生任何 GPU 流量，直接返回空向量：[src/lib.rs:L197-L200](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L197-L200)。这段保证调度器在极端情况（某步没有可采样行）下可以无顾虑地调用。

第一个 `ensure!`：`steps` 必须与 `params` 逐行平行——`steps[i]` 是第 `i` 行所属请求的「请求内解码步数」，只有 seeded 行会用到它（见 4.3）：[src/lib.rs:L201-L205](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L201-L205)

```rust
ensure!(
    steps.len() == n,
    "select_batch: {} steps for {n} rows",
    steps.len()
);
```

第二个 `ensure!`：批大小不得超过 scratch 容量，错误信息带上两侧数字，方便定位是调度器放行了过大的批：[src/lib.rs:L206-L210](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L206-L210)。它对应的集成测试是 `batch_larger_than_scratch_is_rejected`（2 行批塞进 1 行 scratch，断言返回 `Err`）：[tests/select_batch.rs:L221-L240](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L221-L240)。

第三个 `ensure!`：arena 至少要有 `n` 行。允许 `seq_len > n`（arena 可以比本步采样的行更多），但绝不允许少于 `n`：[src/lib.rs:L211-L215](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L211-L215)。

第四个 `ensure!`：arena 的 `hidden_dim` 必须等于 scratch 构造时的 vocab——宽度不符说明调用方换了个模型/词表却复用了旧 scratch：[src/lib.rs:L217-L222](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L217-L222)。

```rust
let is_argmax = |p: &&SamplingParams| effectively_greedy(p, scratch.selection_width);
let mut tokens = vec![0u32; n];
```

`tokens` 先全零初始化；接下来三段路径各自认领自己那部分下标，互不重叠（见 4.4）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：把四条校验与「哪条测试钉住它」对上号，并能预测每条校验失败时的错误文本。

   - 打开 [tests/select_batch.rs:L221-L240](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L221-L240)，确认它踩中的是第二条（容量）；
   - 在纸上写出另外三条校验各自的最小触发方式（例如：传 `&[0]` 给 2 行 params 触发第一条；用 `SampleScratch::new(ctx, 8, 1)` 配 16 宽 arena 触发第四条）。
3. **需要观察的现象**：错误信息里带不带两侧数字（如 `2 rows exceeds scratch capacity 1`）。
4. **预期结果**：四条校验都能在 GPU 工作开始之前拒绝调用；错误信息足以判断是调度器还是 scratch 构造方的责任。
5. 若想实际运行触发（需 GPU 构造 `DeviceContext`）：**待本地验证**——本机无 GPU 时，纸面推演即完成本实践。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么超容量时不做成「自动扩容 scratch」，而是报错？
**答案**：解码路径的设备缓冲地址被 CUDA 图烘焙，要求指针稳定（u2-l2）；扩容意味着换新缓冲、换新地址，等于每步重分配，破坏图捕获。正确的分层是调度器按 `scratch.max_rows()` 限制批大小，采样层只负责拒绝违约调用。

**练习 2**：`ensure!(logits.seq_len >= n)` 允许 `seq_len > n`。这对调用方有什么用？
**答案**：arena 可以一次准备多于本步要采样的行（例如统一形状的执行缓冲），`select_batch` 只按行号 `0..n-1` 采样前 `n` 行；只要行数不少于 `n` 就不越界。

**练习 3**：如果把 `is_argmax` 闭包里的 `scratch.selection_width` 改成 `scratch.vocab`，哪类请求的行为会变？
**答案**：使用了 `with_selection_width` 垫宽的场景（如 qwen35 的 tile 对齐，#1046）：`top_p` 落在 \( 1/V_{\text{emittable}} < \text{top\_p} \le 1/V_{\text{arena}} \) 的行会从 argmax 路径错误地掉进采样器，在 bf16 并列最大值上随机化。回归测试 [tests/select_batch.rs:L180-L219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L180-L219) 的对照组专门钉住了这一点。

### 4.2 greedy 行批式 indexed argmax

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

第一路处理「确定性行」：不管贪心是显式的（`temperature=0`）还是语义等价的（`top_p <= 1/selection_width` 核坍缩），这些行的正确答案都只有一个——分布的最大值下标。把它们**全部合并成一次批式 indexed argmax**：

- **indexed** 的含义：argmax 核不扫整张 arena 的所有行，而是按一张行号表只取贪心行。行号表是紧凑的（长度 = 贪心行数），所以一次调用无论批内 1 行还是 64 行贪心，都只有一次 H2D、一次核发射、一次 D2H。
- **确定性**：argmax 核对 bf16 并列最大值按**最低下标**破并列。这与拒绝采样器「并列时靠种子随机挑一个」形成对照——正是 u2-l1 讲过的必须改道 argmax 的理由。
- **为什么不省掉 D2H**：调用方（引擎）需要把 token id 发回请求方，主机必须拿到这个 `u32`。所以这一路注定有一次设备→主机回读，也注定要等它（否则 `tokens` 里是垃圾）。回读的内存与同步纪律（pinned 页、`stream_spin_wait`）在 u4-l2 有专题，本讲只需要知道「等的是这次拷贝自己的事件」。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
greedy = [i32; 满足 is_argmax 的行号，升序]          # 主机侧紧凑列表
若 greedy 非空：
    memcpy_htod(greedy → scratch.row_indices)         # ① H2D：上传行号表
    argmax_batch_bf16_split_indexed_into(             # ② 核：按行号表做两阶段 argmax
        logits, row_indices, greedy.len(),
        partial_values, partial_indices,              #    split 归约的中间产物
        top1_values,                                  #    每 argmax 行的 top-1 logit（本函数不读）
        argmax_out)                                   #    每 argmax 行一个 token id
    memcpy_dtoh(argmax_out → scratch.argmax_host)     # ③ D2H：pinned 落地
    stream_spin_wait(ctx)                             # ④ 只等这次拷贝的事件
    for (k, row) in greedy:                           # ⑤ 按行号散写
        tokens[row] = argmax_host[k] as u32
```

「两阶段 split argmax」是宽词表（15 万列）下的经典手法：先把每行切成 4096 宽的条带各算局部最大（partials 缓冲，长度公式见 u2-l2），再归约出全局 argmax。本讲把它当黑盒，只关心它的输入输出约定。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`top1_values` 是这个核的输出，为什么 `select_batch` 不读它？
**答案**：它是 argmax 核接口要求的 out-param（每行 top-1 logit 值）。`select_batch` 只要 token id；top-1 值的消费者在别处（比如需要把 logit 值继续参与归约的调用方），这里只是把缓冲借给核写。

**练习 2**：如果贪心行只有 1 行，这套 H2D→核→D2H→等待 的流程是否浪费？为什么仍然值得？
**答案**：单看一次调用确实有固定开销，但这条路径的意义在于**批内多行合并**与**统一入口**：混批时一次 indexed argmax 同时服务所有贪心行；且指针全部落在常驻 scratch 上，解码路径可被 CUDA 图捕获（u4-l1 的分阶段路径正是它的图友好变体）。

**练习 3**：`tokens[row as usize] = out[k] as u32` 里连续两次类型转换，各自在转换什么？
**答案**：`row as usize` 把设备行号表的 i32 下标转回 Rust 索引类型；`out[k] as u32` 把核输出的 i32 token id 转成对外的 `u32`（词表 id 用无符号表示，i32 是设备缓冲的传输格式）。

### 4.3 非 greedy 行：批式 FlashInfer 采样与 seeded 单行

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

第二、三路处理真正需要「抽签」的行，按**有没有请求级种子**再切一刀：

- **无种子行（第二路）**：合并成一次 `gpu_sample_batch_into` 批式调用，共用引擎本步的种子。行与行的随机流靠 philox **子序列**去相关——批内第 `i` 行用的是这个种子下的第 `i` 条子序列。这是服务常态：绝大多数请求不带种子，追求的是批式吞吐。
- **带种子行（第三路）**：逐行构造**单元素**批，以 `mix_seed(request_seed, steps[i])` 为种子单独调用。原因在函数文档里写得很清楚：FlashInfer 的核把**批内位置**折进 philox 子序列——同一行在批首、批尾会拿到不同的随机流。要让「token 是 (seed, step, 分布) 的纯函数」这个可重放契约成立（与批组合、邻居、引擎种子都无关），唯一办法是让批内位置恒为 0，即单行调用（`blockIdx` 恒 0，[src/lib.rs:L293-L295](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L293-L295) 的注释）。
- **min_p 的自动分区**：`BatchSamplingRow` 携带 `min_p` 字段，但调用方**不需要**按 min_p 预先分组——`gpu_sample_batch_into` 内部会把 `min_p > 0` 的行切出来单独跑一遍。为什么在底层做而不在上层做？底层文档给了两个理由：min_p 核的 u 缩放（\( u \cdot q \)）与幸存者谓词和融合快路径不同，min_p=0 的行若搭错车会抽出不同的 token；在底层统一分区，能把「min_p=0 的行永远走原始快路径」变成对所有调用方都成立的承诺（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L87-L93](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L87-L93)）。

`BatchSamplingRow` 的契约值得读一遍：贪心行（`temperature <= 0` 或 `top_k == 1`）明确**不属于**这个类型的目标用户，`top_k <= 0` 表示禁用，`min_p = 0.0` 表示禁用：[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L14-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L14-L29)。`select_batch` 的 argmax 过滤恰好保证了送进来的行都满足这份契约。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

第二路（无种子批式）：

```text
sampling_rows = [BatchSamplingRow { row, temperature, top_k, top_p, min_p }
                 for (i, p) in params if !is_argmax(p) && p.seed.is_none()]
若非空：
    sampled = gpu_sample_batch_into(ctx, logits.as_ref(), sampling_rows,
                                    seed,            # 引擎本步种子
                                    &mut scratch.sampling)
    for (r, token) in sampling_rows.zip(sampled):
        tokens[r.row] = token
```

`gpu_sample_batch_into` 内部（对上层透明）：

```text
若全部行同属一类（全 min_p 或全非 min_p）→ 单趟直通
否则：
    (minp, plain) = rows.partition(r.min_p > 0)
    plain_tokens = 采样(plain, seed)                       # 融合快路径
    minp_seed   = seed ^ 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15              # 第二把 philox 钥匙
    minp_tokens = 采样(minp, minp_seed)                     # min_p 专用管线
    按原 rows 顺序交错归并两段结果
```

第二把钥匙不是装饰：两趟都从子序列 0 起步，沿用同一个 `seed` 会让 min_p 行 `i` 与 plain 行 `i` 拿到**同一条**均匀随机流，token 之间产生相关性（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs:L107-L111](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/sampling.rs#L107-L111) 的注释）。

第三路（seeded 单行）：

```text
for (i, p) in params:
    if p.seed 是 None: continue            # 无种子行已在第二路处理
    if is_argmax(p):      continue         # seeded 但贪心 → 已走第一路，确定性本就成立
    sampled = gpu_sample_batch_into(ctx, logits.as_ref(),
                                    [BatchSamplingRow { row: i, ... }],
                                    mix_seed(p.seed, steps[i]),   # 请求种子 × 请求内步数
                                    &mut scratch.sampling)
    tokens[i] = sampled[0]
```

```rust

    .iter()
    .enumerate()
    .filter(|(_, p)| !is_argmax(p) && p.seed.is_none())
    .map(|(i, p)| BatchSamplingRow {
        row: i,
        temperature: p.temperature,
        top_k: p.top_k,
        top_p: p.top_p,
        min_p: p.min_p,
```

注意映射时的取舍：`seed` **没有**进入 `BatchSamplingRow`——这个结构只描述分布形状（温度/截断/阈值），随机种子是**每次调用**的参数而非每行的属性。这正是「批式调用共用一个引擎种子、seeded 行单独传混合种子」的接口表达。

### 4.4 结果按行号归位：三路合流与基准语义

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

三路各自产生「自己集合内有序」的结果：argmax 输出按 `greedy` 行号表排序、批式采样输出按 `sampling_rows` 顺序、seeded 每次只有一个元素。而函数的返回契约是**按原始行序的 `Vec<u32>`**（文档 L162-L169：`params[i]` 治理第 `i` 行，返回第 `i` 个 token）。归位（scatter）就是把三种局部顺序映射回全局行号。

归位的正确性依赖一个**划分不变量**：三个集合由两个谓词层层切开——

\[ \underbrace{\{i : \text{is\_argmax}(p_i)\}}_{\text{第一路}} \;\Big|\; \underbrace{\{i : \neg\text{is\_argmax}(p_i) \wedge \text{seed}_i = \bot\}}_{\text{第二路}} \;\Big|\; \underbrace{\{i : \neg\text{is\_argmax}(p_i) \wedge \text{seed}_i = \top\}}_{\text{第三路}} \]

三者两两不相交、并集为全集，所以 `tokens` 的每个下标**恰好被写一次**，初始化的 `0u32` 只是占位，永远不会残留到返回值里。

基准的语义也挂在这套分发上。`benches/select_batch.rs` 固定 Qwen 词表 151 936，扫 batch ∈ {1, 8, 32, 64}，每档跑三种参数混合（[benches/select_batch.rs:L38-L74](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/benches/select_batch.rs#L38-L74)）：

| 档 | 参数 | 全部行落入 | 度量的是什么 |
|----|------|-----------|--------------|
| greedy | `p(0.0, -1, 1.0)` | 第一路 | 批式 indexed argmax 的成本下限（H2D + 核 + pinned D2H + 自旋） |
| sampling | `p(1.0, 50, 0.9)` | 第二路 | FlashInfer 批式采样通道的全额成本（gather + softmax + 采样 + 同步） |
| mixed | 偶数行贪心、奇数行采样 | 第一路 + 第二路 | 常见服务形态：一次调用顺序跑完两条路径 |

基准文件头一句话就是本讲分发模型的浓缩：「Greedy is the batched argmax floor; sampling is the FlashInfer pass; mixed is the common serving case」（[benches/select_batch.rs:L1-L3](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/benches/select_batch.rs#L1-L3)）。mixed 之所以是常态：线上请求天然混着「要确定性输出的」和「要多样性的」，而一份 scratch 的贪心/采样缓冲互不相交、顺序复用，使混批不需要任何额外分配。

另外注意基准循环里的一个细节：每次迭代 `seed = seed.wrapping_add(1)`（[benches/select_batch.rs:L63-L70](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/benches/select_batch.rs#L63-L70)）——忠实模拟「引擎种子每步推进」的调用纪律，而不是反复用同一个种子。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

一次完整 `select_batch` 调用的时序（单线程、单 CUDA 流，顺序排队）：

```text
校验（4.1）
│
├─[第一路] H2D 行号表 → argmax 核 → D2H(pinned) → 自旋等待 → 散写 tokens
├─[第二路] 组装 BatchSamplingRow[] → gpu_sample_batch_into(seed)
│          （内部：plain 趟 [→ min_p 趟] → 归并）→ zip 散写 tokens
├─[第三路] 逐 seeded 行：单行 gpu_sample_batch_into(mix_seed(s, step))
│          → tokens[i] = sampled[0]
│
└─ Ok(tokens)   # 长度 n，第 i 个元素即第 i 行的下一个 token
```

三段的执行顺序固定（贪心 → 批式 → seeded），彼此通过 scratch 复用与流上排队自然串行，无需额外同步（第三路内部每次调用自己会同步回读 token）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `select_batch` 是唯一入口、没有逐行逃生舱：它把 `params` 按「`effectively_greedy` × 有无种子」切成三个互不相交的集合，顺序走三段路径，结果按原始行号合成一个 `Vec<u32>`。
- 顶部四个 `ensure!` 分别守护步数对齐、scratch 容量、arena 行数、vocab 宽度；超容量宁可报错也不扩容，因为解码缓冲的指针稳定性（CUDA 图）高于便利性。
- 贪心行合批走 indexed argmax：紧凑行号表 H2D → 一次核发射 → pinned D2H → 自旋只等该拷贝的事件（传递覆盖同流上更早的 argmax 核）→ 按行号散写。
- 无种子采样行合批走一次 `gpu_sample_batch_into`，共用引擎步种子；`min_p` 行在底层自动分区出自己的 pass（第二把 philox 钥匙防止两趟相关），使「min_p=0 行永远走融合快路径」对一切调用方成立。
- seeded 行逐行单调用、种子为 `mix_seed(request_seed, step)`：FlashInfer 把批内位置折进 philox 子序列，只有单行调用（批内位置恒 0）能让 token 成为 (seed, step, 分布) 的纯函数。
- 基准三档对应三种成本语义：greedy = 批式 argmax 下限，sampling = FlashInfer 通道全额，mixed = 常见服务形态（两路顺序执行，成本近似相加）。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
